---
title: "Manual Coding"
subtitle: "Manual coding of text data, inter-coder reliability, and coding schemes."
---

::: {.callout-note title="Where you are in your learning journey" icon=false}
**Where you come from.** You arrive here from [Pivoting and joining](pivoting-and-joining.qmd). You can reshape and combine data frames.

**What this module adds.** You'll learn how to code content by hand with a codebook, measure inter-coder reliability, and combine the coded data with your other data.

**Why it is valuable.** Manual coding is the 'gold standard' that computational methods are tested against, and it gives you the training data for text classification.

**Where it leads.** Next up: [Text Classification](text-classification.qmd).
:::
